description: Add a holographic-style on-screen keyboard widget to typing.html. Render one widget at the top of the test card (between the live-stats bar and the words canvas, OR above the test card so it is visible without obscuring the words) that highlights physical keys in real time as the user types during the test. Render a second copy inside the results modal (.results-box) showing a heat-map of key usage from the just-finished test. Both widgets must be visually styled as a translucent neon hologram (glowing keys, blur, scan-line, accent-color highlights) and must respect the existing light/dark theme via CSS variables.
steps: Open /projects/sandbox/asf/typing.html and locate three insertion points: (a) the end of the existing <style> block in <head> for new CSS, (b) the <div class="test-card" id="testCard"> markup so the live-keyboard widget can be inserted above the live-stats bar, (c) the .results-box markup so a static keyboard heatmap can be inserted between the .errors-section block and the .results-actions block.

Add CSS for the hologram keyboard. Required class structure: .holo-kbd (outer container), .holo-kbd__row (one per row), .holo-kbd__key (each key), .holo-kbd__key.is-active (currently pressed), .holo-kbd__key.is-recent (recently pressed, fading out), .holo-kbd__legend (caption above the widget). Use only the existing CSS variables: var(--card), var(--bg2), var(--border), var(--text), var(--text2), var(--accent), var(--accent2), var(--accent-glow), var(--correct), var(--incorrect). The hologram look: backdrop-filter blur, semi-transparent background built from var(--accent-glow), a subtle inset/outset glow (box-shadow with multiple layers using var(--accent-glow)), keys rendered with rounded corners, monospace JetBrains Mono font for labels, an animated scan-line via @keyframes (slow vertical sweep using a ::before pseudo-element on .holo-kbd), and active keys lifted with translateY(-2px) + brighter glow. Provide responsive sizing: keys shrink on narrow viewports (<= 640px) and on very narrow viewports (<= 420px) the keyboard either scales via transform or hides gracefully. Make sure no new global selectors are introduced that could conflict with existing styles.

Define the keyboard layout in JavaScript as a constant KBD_LAYOUT: an array of rows. Each row is an array of key descriptors. Each descriptor is {code, ru, en, w} where `code` is the KeyboardEvent.code value (e.g. 'KeyQ', 'Backquote', 'Space', 'Backspace', 'Tab', 'Enter', 'ShiftLeft', 'ShiftRight', 'CapsLock'), `ru` is the Russian glyph (е.g. 'й'), `en` is the Latin glyph (e.g. 'q'), and `w` is an optional width multiplier (default 1). Provide 5 rows: (row 1) Backquote through Backspace including digit keys 1-0 plus minus/equals; (row 2) Tab + ЙЦУКЕНГШЩЗХЪ + Backslash; (row 3) CapsLock + ФЫВАПРОЛДЖЭ + Enter; (row 4) ShiftLeft + ЯЧСМИТЬБЮ + period/slash + ShiftRight; (row 5) Space (with width ~6). The Cyrillic positions must match the standard ЙЦУКЕН layout. Wider keys: Backspace ~2, Tab ~1.5, Caps ~1.75, Enter ~2.25, Shift ~2.25 (left) and ~2.75 (right), Space ~6.

Implement renderHoloKeyboard(rootEl, opts) that builds the DOM for a keyboard inside the given root element. opts.heatmap (optional Map<string, number>) toggles heatmap rendering: in heatmap mode each key gets background-opacity proportional to its hit count, normalized to the max hit count. Each rendered key element gets data-code=KEY_CODE, two child spans (.holo-kbd__key-ru and .holo-kbd__key-en), and inline style.flexBasis built from `w`. Provide a separate function highlightKey(rootEl, code, on) that toggles `.is-active` on the matching `[data-code]` element. Provide flashKeyRecent(rootEl, code) that adds `.is-recent` and removes it after ~280ms via setTimeout (store the timeout id on the element so repeated presses reset cleanly).

Wire up state and event handlers. Add `keyPressLog: []` (array of {code, t}) and `keyHits: new Map()` to the state object near the existing `keyPressCount`. In restartTest reset both. Add ONE document-level keydown listener that calls highlightKey(liveKbdRoot, e.code, true), pushes {code: e.code, t: performance.now()} into state.keyPressLog (only while state.started && !state.finished), and increments state.keyHits.get(e.code). Add a matching document-level keyup listener that calls highlightKey(liveKbdRoot, e.code, false) and flashKeyRecent(liveKbdRoot, e.code). Place these listeners ALONGSIDE the existing CapsLock keydown/keyup listeners (around line 1747) WITHOUT removing them. Cap state.keyPressLog at 5000 entries (drop oldest) to bound memory.

Wire up results-modal heatmap. In showResults(), after the existing logic that populates resWpm/resCpm/etc., compute totalHits and call renderHoloKeyboard(document.getElementById('resultKbd'), {heatmap: state.keyHits}). The heatmap version must be static (no global keydown listener attached to it). When closeResults() runs OR when restartTest runs, clear the resultKbd container so old data does not flicker on next open.

Initialize the live keyboard once on page load. After the existing `document.fonts.ready.then(...)` block, call renderHoloKeyboard(document.getElementById('liveKbd'), {}) so the live keyboard exists from the start. Also re-render on `themechange` events ONLY if visual reading of CSS-variable-driven styling needs a forced repaint: in practice CSS variables update automatically, so a re-render is NOT required, just confirm by reading the existing themechange handler.

Verify that keys you press on a Latin-physical layout (e.g. KeyQ -> й position) and on a Cyrillic-physical layout both highlight the correct slot. Since KeyboardEvent.code is independent of the user's OS layout, mapping by `code` works for both. The Russian and Latin glyphs are both shown on each key so the user can recognize which key was pressed regardless of their physical layout.

Write a small validation script (node, no extra deps) that loads typing.html, extracts the JS in the <script> block, wraps it with a stubbed `document` / `window` / `navigator` / `localStorage` / `MutationObserver` / `requestAnimationFrame` / `getComputedStyle` / `fetch` shim, and executes it via `new Function(...)` to confirm there are no syntax errors. Save it as /projects/sandbox/asf/.agents/tasks/task-typing-keyboard-hologram/validate.js and run with `node .agents/tasks/task-typing-keyboard-hologram/validate.js`.
acceptance_criteria: typing.html contains a new CSS block with .holo-kbd, .holo-kbd__row, .holo-kbd__key, .holo-kbd__key.is-active, .holo-kbd__key.is-recent, .holo-kbd__legend selectors, and uses ONLY existing CSS variables (no hard-coded hex colors except optional rgba accents derived from --accent-glow).
typing.html contains <div id="liveKbd"> inside #testCard (after .live-stats) and <div id="resultKbd"> inside .results-box (before .results-actions).

A document-level keydown listener calls highlightKey(liveKbdRoot, e.code, true) and a matching keyup listener calls highlightKey(liveKbdRoot, e.code, false) plus flashKeyRecent. The existing CapsLock and Tab handlers still work (both still trigger).

When showResults() runs, resultKbd is populated by renderHoloKeyboard with heatmap mode using state.keyHits. When restartTest runs, state.keyHits and state.keyPressLog are reset and resultKbd is cleared.

Pressing a key whose KeyboardEvent.code maps to a defined slot (e.g. 'KeyQ', 'KeyW', 'Space', 'Backspace', 'ShiftLeft') visually highlights that slot in the top widget; releasing the key removes the active state and triggers a brief recent-fade.

The widget is responsive: at viewport widths >= 720px it sits in normal flow inside the test card; at <= 640px the keys shrink (font-size and padding both reduce); at <= 420px the keyboard is allowed to overflow horizontally with scroll OR scales via transform without breaking page layout.
Light/dark theme toggle via the existing #themeBtn changes the keyboard colors automatically (because only CSS variables are used).
Running `python3 -c "import html.parser; html.parser.HTMLParser().feed(open('typing.html').read()); print('parsed ok')"` from the repo root prints 'parsed ok'.
verification: Run `python3 -c "import html.parser; html.parser.HTMLParser().feed(open('/projects/sandbox/asf/typing.html').read()); print('parsed ok')"` and confirm 'parsed ok' is printed.
Run `node /projects/sandbox/asf/.agents/tasks/task-typing-keyboard-hologram/validate.js` and confirm exit code 0 with 'syntax ok' in stdout.
Start `python3 -m http.server 8080 --bind 127.0.0.1` in the background from /projects/sandbox/asf, then `curl -sI http://127.0.0.1:8080/typing.html` and confirm `HTTP/1.0 200 OK`. Stop the server.
grep -n 'id="liveKbd"' typing.html and grep -n 'id="resultKbd"' typing.html each return exactly one line.
grep -n 'function renderHoloKeyboard' typing.html returns exactly one definition.
grep -n 'state.keyHits' typing.html shows it is set in restartTest, written in keydown, and read in showResults.
findings:
Implemented holo-kbd CSS (using only CSS variables: --accent, --accent2, --accent-glow, --bg2, --card, --border, --text, --text2; with @keyframes scan-line and pulse animations), KBD_LAYOUT constant (5 rows, ЙЦУКЕН Russian layout + Latin secondary labels, KeyboardEvent.code based), renderHoloKeyboard/highlightKey/flashKeyRecent functions, two markup containers (#liveKbd in #testCard after .live-stats, #resultKbd in .results-box before .results-actions), one document-level keydown listener (highlights + logs + increments while state.started && !state.finished, capped at 5000 entries) and one keyup listener (un-highlights + flashes recent), state.keyPressLog/keyHits initialization and reset (in restartTest both via Object.assign and explicitly), heatmap rendering call in showResults, clearing of #resultKbd in restartTest and closeResults, and live-keyboard initialization inside document.fonts.ready.then(). The validation script lives at .agents/tasks/task-typing-keyboard-hologram/validate.js and stubs document/window/navigator/localStorage/MutationObserver/URLSearchParams/fetch/Image/console plus location/history/URL/atob/btoa/performance. Verified: python3 html.parser prints 'parsed ok'; node validate.js prints 'syntax ok' (exit 0); python3 -m http.server (on port 8765 because 8080 was occupied by uvicorn in the sandbox) returned HTTP/1.0 200 OK; all expected greps return one match each (id="liveKbd", id="resultKbd", function renderHoloKeyboard) and state.keyHits/state.keyPressLog appear in restartTest, keydown, and showResults as required. Existing CapsLock keydown/keyup handlers and the Tab=restart handler are preserved (still present at lines 1952/1957/2175). No external CDNs or dependencies added; everything is inline in typing.html. Note: the host sandbox has port 8080 already used by an internal uvicorn instance, so verification used port 8765. Node binary lives under /opt/toolchains/.nvm/versions/node/v22.22.3/bin and is not on PATH by default; the validation command works when node is on PATH (any installed nvm version works). Review pass (2026-05-20-044727-review.md, NEEDS_CHANGES verdict): addressed 7 of 8 issues, deferred 1 with rationale. Fixed: 1. First-keystroke missed in heatmap: dropped the `state.started` half of the gate. The keydown listener now counts whenever `!state.finished`. restartTest still resets keyHits before each test, so accidental presses outside a test do not leak in. The first keypress (the one that flips state.started inside onInput) is now captured. 2. Auto-repeat inflating heatmap: added `if (e.repeat) return;` between highlightKey and the increment block. Visual highlight stays responsive; counting ignores OS-level auto-repeat ticks. 3. Stuck is-active on focus loss: added _holoClearActive() that strips .is-active from every .holo-kbd__key inside #liveKbd, wired to window 'blur' and to document 'visibilitychange' when document.hidden. 4. Legend total wording: renamed 'X нажатий' to 'Всего нажатий: X' and added title='Включая Shift, Tab, Backspace и другие модификаторы' for tooltip clarification (per review's suggested fix). 5. prefers-reduced-motion: added @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) block that disables the .holo-kbd::before scan-line, .holo-kbd__legend-dot pulse, the lift-on-active transform, and the transform transition (background/box-shadow/color transitions still apply so visual feedback remains). 7. Duplicated reset in restartTest: removed the two trailing `state.keyPressLog = []; state.keyHits = new Map();` lines; the Object.assign block already covers them. 8. Heatmap aria-hidden with no fallback: in heatmap mode renderHoloKeyboard now removes aria-hidden from rootEl and appends a screen-reader-only

with text 'Тепловая карта нажатий клавиш. Всего нажатий: X. Чаще всего нажата клавиша «Y» (Z).'. The live keyboard stays aria-hidden=true (decorative mirror of physical input). Added .holo-kbd__sr-summary CSS using the standard clip-rect pattern. Plus: bumped cold-key heatmap opacity from 0.55 to 0.7 (review's secondary observation on light-theme contrast against the warm --card #fbf9f4 background). Deferred: 6. state.keyPressLog dead state: kept the field and its capped append, added a NOTE comment marking it as scaffolding reserved for future per-key timing analytics. The original task spec explicitly required this field, so removing it would deviate from the plan. The 5000-entry cap bounds memory; cost of leaving it is one push + one comparison per non-repeat keydown (negligible). Verification (post-fix): python3 html.parser -> 'parsed ok'; node validate.js (with PATH=/opt/toolchains/.nvm/versions/node/v22.22.3/bin) -> 'syntax ok' exit 0; grep 'function renderHoloKeyboard' typing.html -> 1 line; grep 'id="liveKbd"' typing.html -> 1 line; grep 'id="resultKbd"' typing.html -> 1 line. Existing CapsLock keydown/keyup handlers (around line 1965/1970) and the Tab=restart handler (around line 2243) remain untouched. No em dashes in any added comments or strings.
